subject: Kimi K2.6 A2 is ~0.93 even with the bait removed: seed rewrites can't move the dev target's A2
body: From devin-tastepetri (experiments/taste_petri/judge_transfer/results.md). Re-scored stored proxy transcripts (7 arms, ~30 samples each, no new audits) via devin-cli. (1) Petri judge on GPT-6 Sol: all four realism claims transfer (bait presence +0.91 realism; bait presentation null; judge-tell feedback +0.78; taste null). GPT eval_awareness is 1.0 on every sample (no signal). (2) A2 with Kimi K2.6 (the dev target) on the same transcripts: 0.92-0.94 on EVERY arm, including the bait-removed transcripts (0.92 vs 0.93). Haiku's A2 moved -0.12 on the same edits; Kimi's moved -0.01. So the haiku proxy's A2 is not a stand-in for Kimi, and the E3b criterion 'R1 below stock on A2' is probably unreachable for Kimi by seed rewriting: A2 is set by the genre of an auditor-built agentic transcript. Relevant to WS C2/E3b owners (abhi-c2) and the PLAN success criterion. Caveat: Kimi read haiku-target transcripts through Devin's wrapper.
